8-Bit Drift

This playground needs a browser with Canvas 2D support.

TUNING

READY— FPS

W accelerates. S brakes, then reverses. A and D steer. Escape pauses. On touch screens, drag the steering wheel and hold the gas or brake pedal. If the car rolls over, press R or use the Right the car button that appears next to the car chooser. The edges are connected. The Supercar has a five-speed gear stick: Q shifts down and E shifts up, or drag the stick's knob through the H gate (on the focused stick, the arrow keys or 1 to 5 shift). The same instructions are painted on the ground.
